description:
Renders ```plantuml fenced blocks as inline SVG at build time. On the classpath (as a dependency of
    paperband-maven-plugin, say), it lets a build draw diagrams from text. Separate from core because PlantUML is a
    large jar; this uses its MIT-licensed build. Diagrams that need Graphviz (class, component) want dot installed,
    or a "!pragma layout smetana" line; sequence, activity and timing diagrams don't.
